fieldValues.title: The run is more cautious than the people in the room about what was decided
fieldValues.summary: Meeting B's hand-written minutes record three decisions; the run recorded one as a decision and left two as a record and a discussion. A first trial of meeting A marked almost every decision point ambiguous and drafted no decisions until the guidance was changed.
evidence: Meeting B decision points: 4 settled, 1 of them unambiguous
Meeting A trial 1: 19 decision points, 0 decisions; final run: 17 and 2
fieldValues.body: Counter-evidence for unattended use: an unlabelled transcript does not show who agreed, and a person who was there knows more. The decision log lists every decision point with its status so a secretary can promote one.
